cards.title: Childhood Sexual Abuse: Supporting Family Victims
cards.body: When a family member discloses abuse, prioritize making them feel safe and heard at their own pace. Assess any ongoing danger the perpetrator poses to younger family members and seek appropriate support.

cards.title: Empty Nest: Navigating Your Child's University Years
cards.body: Sending your first-born to university triggers unexpected emotions beyond the 'natural' empty nesting phase. Acknowledging these feelings while supporting their independence is key to this major life transition.

cards.title: Families at Music Festivals Create Magic
cards.body: Taking toddlers to festivals isn't spoiling the experience—it adds a different kind of joy. Parenting with young children means reimagining leisure, not abandoning it.

cards.title: Parenting Mistakes Don't Mean Lifelong Blame
cards.body: Apologizing for parenting errors doesn't require accepting endless criticism or financial rescue of adult children. Taking responsibility means accountability without sacrificing your own boundaries.

cards.title: Why Praise Can Be Processed as Pressure
cards.body: When children ask you to stop saying 'good job' or bragging about them, it's because praise feels like pressure rather than support. Understanding this helps you celebrate their achievements in ways that actually help.

cards.title: The Trouble With Time-Outs as Discipline
cards.body: Time-outs are commonly recommended for managing unwanted behavior, but they often fail in practice. Understanding why can help parents choose more effective discipline strategies.

cards.title: AuDHD: When Autism and ADHD Combine
cards.body: Having both autism and ADHD (AuDHD) creates challenges beyond experiencing each condition separately. Parents of children with both diagnoses face unique parenting considerations.

cards.title: Food Rules Create Anxiety in Children
cards.body: Rigid food rules often harm children's relationship with eating, triggering anxiety and guilt rather than healthy habits. Flexible approaches support better long-term nutrition and wellbeing.
